terra.problem: A 'long' look adds a duration the text does not give.
Comparing the dry bones to something fresh from the oven makes light of human remains.
Calling warm bones cozy and comparing them to fresh cookies makes light of human remains.
Saying he'd love a tidy stack of the bones makes human remains the joke.
Comparing the bodies with no breath to unbaked cookies makes light of death.
The text says the breath is called from the four winds, not that it comes on the winds.
'A minute ago' adds a time interval the text does not give.
'It comes from the One who says it' is a flat tautology rather than an explanation.
The text does not say the people rose from dust. God promises that His people will live, while the bones in the vision came to life and stood.
